definitions.M_i: integral (r_i-r0_i) dQ over finite Si and all time
definitions.M_ij: integral (r_i-r0_i)(r_j-r0_j) dQ over finite Si and all time
definitions.M_t: integral ((t-epoch_s)/1e-12) dQ over finite Si and all time
definitions.M_tt: integral ((t-epoch_s)/1e-12)^2 dQ over finite Si and all time
definitions.domain: Exact prescribed finite silicon material mask; integrate all time without tail renormalization
definitions.normalization: None: charge-weighted raw moments, never divide features by Q
definitions.source_present: 1 for an explicitly prescribed positive source; 0 only for explicitly absent or zero input source, never for missing inputs or failed integration
definitions.zero_interpretation: All 13 features are zero; explanatory centroid/covariance/time variance are null; no claim of measured native zero

event_protocol.arm: H: original QGSP_BIC with EM Option4
event_protocol.event_denominator: Every original requested/completed event retained, including zero positive Si deposition
event_protocol.rows: All positive Si edep-NIEL steps, including zero-length and arbitrarily late rows; no secondary-species filter
event_protocol.scope: Standard neutron tracking limit belongs to existing physics list; no neutron primary study

geometry.doping_transport: SN affects bound electrical input identity only; original G4 Si/SiO2 materials have no doping-dependent transport model
geometry.rule: Each complete event binds its own supplied D3 model/geometry and actual compiled header/binary; never relabel the old S2 binary

kernel: Sum original positive Si ionizing-step charges times uniform segment-u convolution of normalized isotropic 3D Gaussian exp(-r^2/w^2), w=0.03um, and Gaussian time sigma=2ps; includes all zero-length and late source rows

matrix.SN_axis: Data design registration remains separate; repeated same seed/event across SN is correlated
matrix.development: Original train conditions and their exact listed seeds only
matrix.final_holdout: All original interpolation/depth/energy/joint conditions remain never_for_tuning, regardless of SN or rename

numerics.feature_refinement_gate: abs(delta)<=100*normalized_absolute*max(1,allocated_charge_fC)+10*relative*abs(refined_value), with numbers expressed in each declared feature unit
numerics.interpretation: Numerical repeatability evidence, not a rigorous error bound or native source qualification

origins.proton_epoch: Original matrix 15 ns converted by exact decimal unit conversion; add every native Geant4 step global time
origins.proton_r0: Original request.json target_um, exactly (-.052,0,0) um; never a native measured centroid

permitted_inputs: Input geometry and model source parameters
scope: Conditional device-response source summary from complete native Geant4 proton events and bound BCAT inputs. Unregistered multi-condition candidate; no native source/electrical qualification or population-risk claim.
